parameters.name: DataPlaneMode
parameters.description:
The data plane mode of the namespace. This parameter is valid only if Ambient Mesh mode is enabled for the Service Mesh instance. Valid values:

- ambient: Sets the data plane mode of the namespace to ambient.

- sidecar: Sets the data plane mode of the namespace to sidecar.

parameters.name: EnableIstioInjection
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable automatic injection.

parameters.name: EnableSidecarSetInjection
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable SidecarSet injection.

parameters.name: IstioRev
parameters.description: The injection version for the namespace. This parameter is valid only during a canary upgrade of the service mesh. If you specify IstioRev, do not specify EnableIstioInjection or EnableSidecarSetInjection.
